messages:
devon: Quick async — aligning on runtime perf sprint. Kernel low-latency milestone due next Tue. Need owners for: 1) microkernel PRs (PR#8421), 2) continuous-batching rollout, 3) KV cache eviction heuristics. Callout: perf CI is flaking on sequence_length=2048.

anita: Taking microkernel PRs (I'll shepherd reviews). I queued PR #8421 -> waiting on linux-kernel-tests. Saw OOM in run-3.

liam: I'll own continuous-batching rollout. Plan: staging canary tomorrow. What's our canary latency SLO? 50ms p95?

carmen: I'll own KV eviction heuristics. Need perf traces from the latest canary. @devon can you drop the trace query?

devon: Sure — quick trace query (telemetry):
```
select percentile(latency_ms,95) as p95
from traces
where service='runtime' and tag='kv-evict' and ts > now()-24h;
```
Also created ticket RT-1294 for the kernel-tests OOM: `OOM after 1.2GB` in run-3.

anita: Ack. I'm looking into OOM — container image bump to 1.17 reset cgroups memory limits. Will report back.

liam: Canary plan: 10% traffic, 12h observation window. Fallback if p95 regresses >10% or error_rate >0.1%. Will post dashboard link once ready.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> staging at 2026-03-19T02:00Z. CI gates: unit, integration, perf.

carmen: Small ask — need KV metrics (heatmap + hit ratio) for the canary nodes. @anita can we enable sampling on canary?

anita: Yep — will enable sampling flag `--kv-sample=1` on canary nodes and push infra PR #227.

devon: Owners set: microkernel = anita, continuous-batching = liam, kv-evict = carmen. Action: each owner pls post status + PRs/tickets by EOD. Thanks :rocket:
